chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr, from 'Asim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام about a man who doubted in the first rak'ah. He said: He must begin again.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts in the first rak'ah of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer), specifically when doubt occurs in the first rak'ah. Abu Ja'far عليه السلام rules that the prayer is to be restarted, indicating the seriousness of uncertainty in the first two rak'ahs.
